purpose: Lifecycle status for every render pass / pipeline family so future slices MOVE a pass one step forward instead of re-deciding from scratch whether it should be modeled. Source of truth for scripts/check-pass-coverage.py.

status_legend.UNREGISTERED: ad-hoc GL state; no PipelineDesc row. next = register (or recon).
status_legend.DESCRIPTIVE_REGISTERED: PipelineDesc row exists + checked, but NOT applied via applyPipeline (state still hand-set).
status_legend.VISUAL_PROVEN: routed AND a before/after pixel-identical (or perceptual) gate passed.
status_legend.SPIRV_ELIGIBLE: visual-proven AND the shader family is baked + selectable as offline SPIR-V.
status_legend.DO_NOT_MODEL: intentionally never a static PipelineDesc row (dynamic-state emulator, non-draw, or not-a-pass). REQUIRES reason.

Legacy quad fallback + GPU-driven MDI sub-variant NOT modeled.

The pass is DETERMINISTIC (3-run byte-stable cb5a700ebd00), DRAWS (19184 [PIPELINE_BIND] WaterArmed binds = SAMPLES rasterized), and its bound state is trace-confirmed identical to the legacy hand-set GL state. VFX.evidence: VFX-VISUAL-GATE-1 (2026-06-23) built the full gate + proved TWO of three facts, but the pass is CONFIRMED pixel-nondeterministic so VISUAL_PROVEN is withheld (honest). PROVEN: (1) tube coverage — MC2_VFX_ORACLE_TUBE occlusion oracle samples=3325 into the scene FBO (fbo=1), the tube VFX pass rasterizes; (2) additive NOT collapsed — runtime [PIPELINE_BIND] blend= trace (new this slice) shows VfxTubeAdditive=AdditiveOneOne (ONE/ONE) vs VfxBillboardAdditive=AdditiveSrcAlphaOne (SRC_ALPHA/ONE); the static check-vfx-blend-distinction.py catches a collapse at check-time (proven: FAILs on a planted tube->billboard collapse). NOT PROVEN: 3-run pixel stability — captures DRIFT (max_abs_delta=241), particle output is not seeded by MC2_SMOKE_SEED (sim-freeze froze the clock but not the particle RNG). Per scope (no weakening the test for nondeterminism), the byte/perceptual gate honestly FAILS.
VFX.proofNote: Routing + blend-distinction are GOVERNANCE-COMPLETE (checker + runtime trace catch the tube ONE/ONE vs billboard/mesh SRC_ALPHA/ONE collapse). VISUAL_PROVEN requires either (a) a deterministic particle seed so 3-run capture is stable (engine work, out of this slice's scope), or (b) operator acceptance that oracle_coverage + blend-non-collapse is sufficient proof for a deliberately-nondeterministic pass. Held at ROUTED/pending until that decision.
